newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen leases included in federal unit.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen leases included in federal unit.

text.p: Evergreen Resources Inc said Tuesday the Bureau of Land Management has designated about 33,000 acres of Evergreen's Raton Basin oil and gas leases as a new Federal Unit called the Sangre de Cristo Unit.
Evergreen Operating Corp, a subsidiary, has been named Unit Operator, the company said.
Formation of the unit allows Evergreen to base development drilling decisions within the Unit on technical and geologic data rather than the fulfillment of term lease obligations, the company said.
Evergreen's unit obligation is to establish commercial production through the drilling of two new wells in the Unit during 1997, it added.

The previously formed 67,000 acre Spanish Peaks Unit combined with the new Sangre de Cristo Unit represent approximately 83 percent of Evergreen's 120,000 gross acres in the Raton Basin, which is located on the Colorado/New Mexico border. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
